sources.title: PM 20 - PhoxX Diodenlaser - Stand 09-01-21_EN
evidence: PhoxX is presented as a new laser series from Omicron.
Described as OEM diode laser series with RS-232 and USB interfaces.

applied_profile_updates.name: PhoxX 二极管激光器
applied_profile_updates.description: PhoxX 是 Omicron-Laserage 的 OEM 二极管激光器系列，可提供可调激光输出并支持高速调制，常用于显微成像、荧光激发和光学检测系统。
applied_profile_updates.description_en: PhoxX is an OEM diode-laser series from Omicron-Laserage, offering controllable laser output and high-speed modulation for microscopy, fluorescence excitation, and optical instrumentation.
